mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_kb_document( id, tenant_id, title, source_type, category, effective_date, owner, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{title}, #{sourceType}, #{category}, #{effectiveDate}, #{owner}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO tb_kb_document_version( id, tenant_id, document_id, version_no, status, approved_at, raw_content_masked, pipeline_status, pipeline_error_code, pipeline_error_excerpt, pipeline_updated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{documentId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, #{approvedAt}, #{rawContentMasked}, #{pipelineStatus}, NULL, NULL, #{pipelineUpdatedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS document_id, dv.id AS document_version_id, d.title, d.source_type, d.category, d.effective_date, d.owner, dv.version_no, dv.status, dv.pipeline_status, dv.pipeline_error_code, dv.pipeline_error_excerpt, dv.approved_at, dv.updated_at FROM tb_kb_document d JOIN tb_kb_document_version dv ON dv.document_id = d.id AND dv.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.id = #{documentId} ORDER BY dv.version_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id AS document_id, dv.id AS document_version_id, d.title, d.source_type, d.category, d.effective_date, d.owner, dv.version_no, dv.status, dv.pipeline_status, dv.pipeline_error_code, dv.pipeline_error_excerpt, dv.approved_at, dv.updated_at FROM tb_kb_document d JOIN tb_kb_document_version dv ON dv.document_id = d.id AND dv.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.id = #{documentId} AND dv.version_no = #{versionNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT d.tenant_id, d.id AS document_id, dv.id AS document_version_id, dv.version_no, d.title, d.source_type, d.category, d.effective_date, d.owner, dv.raw_content_masked FROM tb_kb_document d JOIN tb_kb_document_version dv ON dv.document_id = d.id AND dv.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dv.id = #{documentVersionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM tb_kb_document_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'approved' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_kb_chunk( id, tenant_id, document_version_id, chunk_no, chunk_hash, chunk_text, token_count, context_header, summary_text, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{documentVersionId}, #{chunkNo}, #{chunkHash}, #{chunkText}, #{tokenCount}, #{contextHeader}, #{summaryText}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO tb_kb_chunk_embedding( id, tenant_id, chunk_id, embedding_vector, embedding_dim, model, embedding_input_text, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{chunkId}, #{embeddingVector}, #{embeddingDim}, #{model}, #{embeddingInputText}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO tb_kb_reindex_job( id, tenant_id, job_type, document_version_id, idempotency_key, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_retry_at, error_code, error_excerpt, requested_by, requested_at, started_at, completed_at, result_message, last_trace_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{jobType}, #{documentVersionId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{errorCode}, #{errorExcerpt}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{resultMessage}, #{lastTraceId}, #{requestedAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, job_type, document_version_id, idempotency_key, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_retry_at, error_code, error_excerpt, requested_by, requested_at, started_at, completed_at, result_message, last_trace_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_kb_reindex_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{nowUtc}) AND attempt_count < max_attempts ORDER BY requested_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_kb_reindex_job SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{startedAt}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, error_code = NULL, error_excerpt = NULL, last_trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{startedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{jobId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{startedAt}) AND attempt_count < max_attempts
